name: Continued Threat
summary: Along the Swamp of Sorrows beach, Katar sees your hatred of the fish men growing like her own.

sections.title: More Along the Beach
sections.body: Katar sends you farther along the beach to hunt marsh inkspewers, marsh flesheaters and marsh oracles. Return when you have had enough of the fight. She will take no pleasure until the sea and all her children are silenced, with the repulsive fish men foremost in her thoughts.

faq.answer: Katar gives you this work on the Swamp of Sorrows beach.

faq.q: What creatures need to be hunted?
faq.answer: Katar wants you to hunt marsh inkspewers, marsh flesheaters and marsh oracles along the beach.

faq.q: Why does Katar want the murlocs culled?
faq.answer: Katar will take no pleasure until the sea and her brood are silenced, especially the fish men.
This follows Threat From the Sea, after which Tok'Kar offered you a weapon.
